issue.body:
Finding key: `sbp-reference-title-whitespace`

The ATP bypass record declares the PMID:31464375 bibliography title with a trailing space and escaped newline at `references[22].title`. Native rendering carries these bytes into the new record page, leaving trailing whitespace on HTML line 732. This would fail the staged whitespace check for the new page.

Target: `data/pathways/sedoheptulose-bisphosphate-bypass.yaml`, reviewed SHA256 `cd59859d1dbcbc6c36961822b02daebc519a80a224ba8fa63d3235933b328101`.

Evidence: root inspected the exact YAML scalar and the actual maintained-render output. The external observation is `/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-230-initial-generated-inspection-20261012.json`. Rendered page SHA256: `dbb3e09bb047a2ca7715696a6a4d8a7eb801461bb7d23ec57eda42512e9de855`.

Correct only the trailing whitespace of this title. Preserve its wording, source binding, every scientific assertion, identifier selector, graph identity, edge/qualifier/evidence object and all other references. Record a native EDIT before rerendering, retain the original accepted scientific/canonical work and full-gate results with their actual target scope, and verify the exact correction and generated metadata delta. Rerender and check native/closed-schema/identifier consumers, KGX, site-current and staged whitespace. Save a current native review that explicitly assesses this external issue.

Severity: minor; bibliography formatting defect, not a changed biological claim.
issue.title: Trim trailing bibliography whitespace in ATP bypass record
